settings.tolerance_hint: How far above the plan price a receipt may land and still be marked as matching. Never below: one cent short always goes to review. Approving is always a person's call.
settings.reject_below_hint: If the amount read falls below this percentage of the price, review flags it as a suggested rejection. Rejecting is still a person's call.
settings.confidence_hint: Below this value, a field read by the AI is flagged as low confidence in the Payments review. It only warns: approval is always a person’s.
settings.reservation_hint: Days a payment may wait for a decision. The checkout promises it to the student, and Payments flags the deadline as overdue past it.
settings.checkout_hold_hint: Minutes the public enrolment holds a seat while the student goes off to pay. When it runs out the seat goes back to the class group and they pick a schedule again.
settings.receipts_notice: Changing a parameter applies to receipts arriving afterwards: it never revalidates a payment already settled.
settings.saved_toast: Changes saved: they apply from now on.

settings.complaint_deadline_hint: Business days, Monday to Friday, from the day the sheet is filed to send the answer. Holidays still count as business days.
settings.classroom_max_hint: How many teachers may use the same Classroom account at a time. Lowering it removes nobody: it only stops more from being assigned.

help.module_what: Which part of the course this class group teaches: one module, or the full course if it goes through all of them.
help.module_how: It decides the material the teacher opens: on a full course they see every module's. If you do not know yet, leave it unset.
help.period_how_manage: Pick here which period to see. To create one or copy another's class groups, use Manage periods, right beside it.
help.period_how_read: Pick here which period to see.
help.period_form_how: Pick the campaign this class group is sold in. If it does not exist yet, pick “+ New period” at the end of the list and fill it in right here.
help.teacher_what: Who teaches the class group. Only active teachers who teach the course's language are listed.
help.teacher_how: Not listed? Add the language on their file, under Teachers. If you do not know yet, leave it empty: it does not stop the class group from opening.
help.classroom_what: One Google Classroom per module this class group teaches. The teacher sees it on their portal, and a student with a confirmed seat on theirs.
help.classroom_how: Copy the link from Classroom and paste it under the module. A full-course class group has one per module. You can do it later.
help.capacity_what: How many students fit in this class group. Seats belong to each class group: 30 seats are 30 students in one group, with its teacher and its schedule.
help.capacity_how_create: More than one group? Raise the Number of class groups: seats can be the same for all or different for each.
help.capacity_how_edit: It cannot go below the seats already taken. To open another group, use New class group on the list.
help.group_count_what: How many identical class groups to open at once: same course, schedule and dates. Each gets its own code.
help.group_count_how: For another schedule, open another one with New class group. You can edit each one from the list afterwards.
help.landing_key_how: Pick the website page that sells this course. Each page answers for one course only: a taken one shows which.
help.min_age_what: The minimum age to enroll in this course.
help.min_age_how: It shows on the enrollment form, which does not let anyone younger continue.
help.modules_what: How many modules the course is split into.
help.modules_how: Each module asks for its material link below, and when creating a class group you pick which one it teaches (or the full course).
help.total_hours_what: The course's total length, in hours.
help.total_hours_how: It is informative: the student sees it when picking the course on the enrollment form.
help.certificate_how: Pick Certification exam only if the course requires it, like Basic English. Otherwise, Minimum grade.
help.materials_how: Paste the full link (https) of the folder or document. If you change the number of modules, check the links before saving.
help.procedures_what: Which procedures this course offers: changing class group (moving to another schedule), freezing the enrollment (pausing and returning at the same module) and transferring it (handing the enrollment to another person).
help.procedures_how: Turn on only those that apply. Intermediate and advanced do not offer freezing.
help.options_how: Prices and plans are on the Plans tab. To take the course off the catalog, use the take-off-catalog card on this tab.
help.course_name_what: The name the student sees for the course.
help.course_language_what: The course's language. It groups the course on the enrollment form and decides which teachers can be assigned to its class groups.
help.course_level_what: The course's level, for example B2 or Basic. It shows next to the name.
help.meet_what: This module group's Google Meet link. The teacher sees it in their portal, and a student with a confirmed seat in theirs, next to the Classroom.
help.meet_how: Copy the meeting link from Meet and paste it here. It is optional and can be done later.
help.payment_state_tabs_what: Open: payments waiting for a person to approve or reject them, from any period. Settled: those already approved or rejected, ordered by when they were decided.
help.payment_state_tabs_how: No payment approves itself: the AI check only guides. To decide, go to the Review queue.
help.payment_status_what: In review: the payment waits for a person's decision, whether or not it passed the AI check. Approved: the seat is confirmed. Rejected: the seat went back to the class group.
help.payment_status_how: On approving or rejecting, the student gets an email with the decision. The decision is recorded and cannot be undone.
help.payment_paid_for_what: What this payment pays for: the enrollment, a procedure (such as the enrollment certificate), monthly modules, or several enrollments with one receipt.
help.payment_paid_for_how: Over capacity: the enrollment sits above the class group's capacity, from a checkout reservation that expired or a team decision. You see it before deciding; it does not change how you decide.
help.payment_amount_what: The amount recorded for the payment. It turns red when it does not match the expected one, shown below it.
help.payment_expected_what: The plan's price, or the procedure's, frozen at enrollment: what the receipt has to pay. For a payment of several courses, the sum of all of them.
help.payment_expected_how: There is never a discount. If the plan's price changes later, this payment still expects the frozen price.
help.payment_queue_sort_what: Oldest first: whoever paid first is answered first. Priority first: rejection suggested, then review, then matches; within each group, the least confident reading first.
help.payment_queue_sort_how: It only changes the order of the queue, not which payments are in it.
help.payment_verdict_what: The AI compares the receipt with what is expected. Matches: amount, operation number and method match. Review: something was not read or does not match. Rejection suggested: the amount is far below.
help.payment_verdict_how: It only guides: no payment is approved or rejected on its own. The tolerance is changed in Settings → Receipt validation.
help.payment_deadline_what: By when to decide this payment: the date it was sent plus the days of the review window. It turns red with less than a day left.
help.payment_deadline_how: Meanwhile, the seat stays reserved for the student. The days are changed in Settings → Receipt validation.
help.payment_receipt_state_what: The file's state: Received (there is an image to review), Uploading (still being processed), File refused (it failed validation) or No receipt.
help.payment_receipt_state_how: Without an image, confirm the deposit on the bank statement before approving. It is a warning: it does not block approving.
help.payment_signals_what: What the anti-fraud screening found: the same file on another payment, an image that was edited or looks like another receipt, or a different payer.
help.payment_signals_how: Some signals send the payment to review, but none rejects it: the decision is yours, looking at the image.
help.payment_compare_what: What the AI read on the receipt next to what is expected: the amount against the frozen price; the operation number and method against what the student declared. Payer and date are only shown.
help.payment_compare_how: Each field carries the AI's confidence, and low confidence is flagged. If you doubt the reading, use Read again: it does not change the payment's status.
help.cg_status_what: Which step the class group is at: Draft, Enrolling, In progress, Finished and Closed. A draft does not show in enrollment.
help.cg_status_how: It only moves forward, one step at a time and always by a person, with the button below — never by date. There is no way back.
help.cg_window_what: From when until when the class group is offered in enrollment, in your time zone. “No limit”: no opening or closing date.
help.cg_window_how: It only applies while the class group is Enrolling. Change it in Edit class group.
help.cg_seats_what: Seats taken out of the class group's capacity, adding up all its module groups. “+2” are enrollments above capacity (over-capacity).
help.cg_seats_how: Over-capacity only comes from an expired hold in enrollment or from the team confirming it. A class group over capacity never shows a free seat again.
help.cg_cert_deadline_what: The completion certificate is free and is delivered within {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}} of the end of classes.
help.cg_cert_deadline_how: Monday to Friday count; public holidays are not subtracted yet. Issuing is a batch, in the Certificates card: nothing goes out on a date by itself.
help.cg_remove_what: Take off the catalog stops offering the class group and is undone with Put back in the catalog. Enrollments already made do not change.
help.cg_remove_how: Delete is forever: a class group nobody touched is erased with its module groups; one with enrollments or payments leaves every catalog screen, and its enrollments and payments stay in Enrollments and Payments.
help.cg_runs_badges_what: Each group's warnings. No Classroom and No Meet: the links the teacher and confirmed students see are missing. No end date: the group's grade register has no deadline.
help.cg_runs_badges_how: They only warn, they block nothing. Fill them in with Edit on the group. “Entry” marks the group every new student lands in.
help.cg_progression_what: Proposes, for each student, moving on to the next module's group or repeating this module in a new attempt, by their official grade. Nothing moves until you confirm.
help.cg_progression_how: A grade in review moves nobody, and with no next-module group open nobody moves on. You can move someone on below the pass mark, with a reason.
help.cg_register_states_what: Not sent: the teacher can still change the grades. In review: sent, waiting for coordination. Returned: back with the teacher, with what to correct. Official: confirmed.
help.cg_register_states_how: Out of time: {hours} hours went by after the module's end without sending it. No end date: the group has no module end date and the register has no deadline.
help.cg_register_states_how_no_hours: Out of time: the deadline after the module's end passed without sending it. No end date: the group has no module end date and the register has no deadline.
help.cg_grade_what: The final exam grade, which is the module's grade: 0 to 20, decimals allowed. DA: did not sit the final exam.
help.cg_grade_how: In review until coordination confirms the register; then it is Official. Corrected: the supervision changed it with a reason, and the history keeps who, when and why.
help.cg_grade_result_what: Compares the grade with today's pass mark, {grade}, as typed, without rounding. DA counts as failed.
help.cg_cert_batch_what: A certificate goes to whoever has an official grade at or above the pass mark in this last module, no DA, and did not fail an earlier module graded on the platform. Attendance does not count.
help.cg_cert_batch_how: Issuing creates the document with its verification code and e-mails the student, and the guardian if a minor. It cannot be undone.
help.cg_monthly_state_what: Paid: a person approved in Payments the payment for the module and attempt the student is on; only then the class opens. Under review: the receipt waits in Payments. To pay: the module is not bought yet.
help.cg_monthly_state_how: “Since”: since when the student is on that module without buying it. Repeating a module is paid again.
help.cg_monthly_ahead_what: Following modules the student already paid in advance. Paying ahead is neither a discount nor a debt.
help.cg_roster_count_what: Students with a confirmed seat in the class group. Who froze their enrollment shows as Frozen but is not counted: the seat went back to the class group.
help.cg_roster_count_how: They come back when coordination returns them to a group of the same course and module.
help.cg_waitlist_what: Who is waiting for a seat in this class group, first come first served. The list is manual and opens when the class group is full.
help.cg_waitlist_how: When a seat frees up, enroll the first one with the link shown above: the manual enrollment takes them off the list. Nobody is enrolled from here.
help.teach_register_what: Your group's grades for this round of the module. Once everyone has a grade, you send it for review; coordination sends it back with what to correct or confirms it, and the grades become official.
help.teach_register_how: Only official grades count for moving on to the next module and for the certificate. Students see their grade as soon as you post it, marked “In review”.
help.teach_register_status_what: Not sent and Returned: the register is yours and you can change grades. In review: coordination is checking it. Official: the grades are confirmed.
help.teach_register_status_how: Out of time: the deadline passed and you haven't sent it yet. Once sent, only supervision can correct a grade.
help.teach_register_deadline_what: You have {hours} hours from the end of the module's last day (Lima time) to send the register for review. If the deadline passes without it, it shows “Out of time”.
help.teach_register_deadline_how: Coordination sets the module's end date. With “No end date”, the register has no deadline yet.
help.teach_register_round_what: A round is one run of the module in your group. If new grades come in after the register is official (students repeating, or a student moved into your group), the next round opens, with its own register and deadline.
help.teach_register_progress_what: How many students in this round already have a grade (or “Did not sit”), out of everyone confirmed in the group.
help.teach_register_progress_how: You can send the register for review once everyone has a grade.
help.teach_grade_what: One grade per student: the final exam's, which is the module's grade. From 0 to 20, decimals allowed; {grade} or more passes. If the student didn't sit the exam, use “Did not sit the final exam”.
help.teach_grade_how: You can change it while the register is yours (not sent, or returned); the student gets each change by email and the previous grade stays in the history. Once sent, only supervision corrects it.
help.teach_progression_what: When the module ends, you confirm who moves on to the next module's group in this class and who repeats this module, in this same group.
help.teach_progression_how: The system suggests based on the grade; you review and confirm. Only official grades count: with a grade in review, that student neither moves on nor repeats. Moving someone on below the passing grade is up to coordination.
help.teach_resources_what: Your class links: the group's Meet, each module's Classroom, and the module's material, which coordination keeps in the course.
help.teach_resources_how: You don't change them: if one is missing, ask coordination. Students see the Meet and Classroom only with a confirmed seat.
help.teach_class_status_what: Where the class stands: enrolling, in progress or finished. It becomes finished when you post the last missing grade, or when coordination moves it forward.
help.teach_class_status_how: A finished class no longer counts as active, but it stays in My class groups in case a grade is missing. When coordination closes it, it leaves your portal.
help.portal_billing_mode_what: Full package: you paid for the course in one go. Monthly: you buy one module at a time, before taking it.
help.portal_billing_mode_how: Monthly is never a debt — no interest, no late fees: if the current module has no approved payment, only your class access is paused until you pay it in Payments.
help.portal_class_lock_what: The padlock means your class access (Meet and Classroom) is paused in the portal. The reason is shown next to it.
help.portal_class_lock_how: If the module's payment is missing, send your receipt in Payments: the class opens once someone on our team approves it, and we let you know by email.
help.portal_enrollment_review_what: We received your enrollment and your receipt. Someone on our team is reviewing the payment.
help.portal_enrollment_review_how: Once it is approved, your seat is confirmed, we let you know by email and your class links show up here.
help.portal_module_purchase_what: On the monthly plan each module is bought separately. Next to each one you see whether it is paid or how its payment is going.
help.portal_module_purchase_how: A module's class opens once someone on our team approves its payment. If you repeat a module, you buy it again.
help.portal_advance_modules_what: The module you are taking comes already ticked. You can also tick the next ones to pay ahead with a single receipt.
help.portal_advance_modules_how: They are ticked in order: you can't pay for a module while an earlier one is unpaid. Paying ahead has no discount, and not paying ahead means you owe nothing.
help.portal_payment_status_what: Pending or Under review: your receipt is waiting for someone on our team. Approved: the payment is confirmed. Rejected: the payment was not approved.
help.portal_payment_status_how: We let you know by email when your payment is approved or rejected.
help.portal_grade_status_what: In review: your teacher has posted the grade, but the coordination has not confirmed it yet, so it can still change. Official: the coordination has confirmed it.
help.portal_grade_status_how: Only the official grade counts for moving to the next module and for the certificate. We email you when it changes or becomes official.
help.portal_requests_what: Requests are paid: you pick the course, send the receipt, and the price is fixed from that day.
help.portal_requests_how: Someone on our team reviews the payment. Once it is approved, the enrollment certificate is issued automatically, we email you, and it shows up in your documents on this same page.
help.portal_request_status_what: Payment under review: we are checking your receipt. In progress: the payment was approved and we are preparing your request. Completed: it is ready.
help.portal_request_status_how: Rejected: the payment was not approved. If you have questions, message us on WhatsApp.
help.portal_gmail_what: Your personal Gmail: you use it to sign in to Google Classroom and to the portal.
help.portal_gmail_how: That is why it can't be changed here. If it needs fixing, message us on WhatsApp.
help.portal_consent_what: If the student is a minor, their guardian must authorize the processing of their personal data (Ley 29733).
help.portal_consent_how: The guardian accepts it when signing in to the portal with their own email. We keep the date and the version of the text accepted.
help.acad_teacher_col_what: Who teaches each module group of the class group. With no teacher, it reaches no teacher's portal: nobody posts its grades.
help.acad_teacher_col_how: Teachers are usually assigned once seats close, from Pending. "Previously listed" is the name typed by hand before teacher files existed: only a hint.
help.acad_seats_what: Seats taken (reserved or confirmed) out of the class group's capacity, across all its module groups. "+2" are enrollments above capacity: the overbooking.
help.acad_seats_how: Overbooking only comes from a reservation that expired in the enrollment form, or from coordination confirming it. A class group over capacity never shows open seats again.
help.acad_status_what: Draft (not on sale) → Enrolling → In progress → Finished → Closed. A class group moves one step at a time, always by hand, never by date.
help.acad_status_how: The badges beside it warn, they do not block: No Classroom is a module missing its link; Off the catalog is a class group taken off sale.
help.acad_bulk_what: Taking off the catalog stops selling the class groups: enrollments stay, and each one can be reactivated from its page. Deleting is forever and cannot be reactivated.
help.acad_bulk_how: On delete, a class group nobody used is erased; one with history is hidden from the whole catalog, and its enrollments and payments stay in Enrollments and Payments.
help.acad_register_grades_what: How many students of this round already have a grade, out of those who need one: the confirmed seats of the module group.
help.acad_register_grades_how: With every grade in, the teacher sends the register to review. A grade posted after an official register (repeaters, moved students) opens the next round.
help.acad_register_status_what: Not sent: the teacher still posts and changes grades. In review: sent, waiting for coordination. Returned: back with the teacher to fix. Official: confirmed.
help.acad_register_status_how: Only an official grade counts to move up a module and for the certificate. Out of time: due and not sent. Sent late: it arrived after the deadline.
help.acad_register_deadline_what: The teacher has {hours} hours, counted from the end of the module's last day (Lima time), to send the register.
help.acad_register_deadline_how: The module's end date is set on the module group, when editing the class group. With no end date, the register has no deadline.
help.acad_register_filter_what: Open shows the registers not official yet: not sent, in review and returned. Official ones are under their own option or All.
help.acad_register_filter_how: Out of time only keeps the ones past due without being sent to review.
help.acad_language_what: The catalog's list of languages. Every course picks its language from here, and so does the teacher file: nobody types it by hand.
help.acad_language_how: A language that already exists under another spelling is refused: capitals, accents and extra spaces do not count.
help.acad_language_manage_what: Renaming fixes the name on every course and teacher at once.
help.acad_language_manage_how: You can only retire it with no courses left in the language: first change each course's language, in its Settings. Teachers who had it lose it from their file.
help.acad_course_status_what: In catalog: the course is on sale. Out of catalog: taken off sale with its plans and class groups; enrollments already made stay, and it can be reactivated.
help.acad_course_status_how: No price: without a plan with a price in force, it does not appear in enrollment. No material: a module is missing its link; fill it in under Settings.
help.acad_plan_billing_what: How the plan is paid. Package: a single payment. Monthly: the student buys one module at a time, and without that module paid and approved they cannot open the class in the portal.
help.acad_plan_billing_how: Chosen when the plan is created and never changes. On monthly, the price is that of one module.
help.acad_price_start_what: The day this price takes effect. A price is never edited: to change it, you schedule a new one.
help.acad_price_start_how: Each enrollment keeps the price in force on the day it was made. Earlier prices stay in Price history.
help.teacher_status_what: Active: on the roster and can be given class groups. Inactive: left the roster; nothing is deleted, and the grades and class groups they taught stay theirs.
help.teacher_status_how: Changed from the file. Making them inactive closes their panel account and stops watching their contract; reactivating reopens it.
help.teacher_load_what: How many module groups they teach in class groups enrolling or in progress. Free: none right now.
help.teacher_load_how: The No class group filter shows only the free ones, the people you look for when a class group needs a teacher.
help.teacher_contract_what: The period the latest recorded contract covers. The panel warns {days} days before it ends, marks it lapsed as soon as the date passes, and No contract when there is none.
help.teacher_contract_how: Generate contract, on the file, records the period and downloads the PDF; the PDF is not kept on the platform. Only watched while the teacher is active.
help.teacher_languages_what: The languages they can teach. When assigning a class group, only active teachers with the course's language appear.
help.teacher_languages_how: The list comes from the Languages tab, in Courses & groups.
help.teacher_availability_what: The weekly time slots in which the teacher can teach.
help.teacher_availability_how: If you assign a class group outside these slots, or on top of another of their class groups in the same period, the form warns but lets you save.
help.teacher_fill_mode_what: With "The teacher fills them in" you record only name, e-mail and languages. Document, phone, origin, address and availability stay empty, all together.
help.teacher_fill_mode_how: The teacher fills them in once, in their portal, after accepting the Team invite; after that only coordination corrects them. Until then, no contract can be generated.
help.admin_doc_versions_what: The draft is the text you work on; the published version is the one the platform uses. Each publication creates a new, numbered version that no longer changes.
help.admin_doc_versions_how: Saving the draft changes no document. Once published, new documents use this text; those already issued or downloaded stay as they were.
help.admin_team_tabs_what: Has access: accounts that sign in to the panel. Invite pending: invitations not yet accepted, with a link that expires. No access: blocked accounts.
help.admin_team_tabs_how: Block is undone with Unblock. Delete cannot be undone: the account leaves every tab and its email is free for a new invitation.
help.admin_team_cargo_what: The role defines what the person can do in the panel. What each role grants is in Roles and permissions.
help.admin_team_cargo_how: Changing a role asks for your password and is kept in the Role history. The Teacher role is not changed here: it goes with the file and is opened and closed in Teachers.
help.admin_team_unlinked_what: A teacher account not linked to any roster file: it sees no class group. It only happens with accounts opened before teacher accounts were linked to the file.
help.admin_team_invite_role_what: The role the person will sign in to the panel with: it defines what they will be able to do.
help.admin_team_invite_role_how: The invitation goes out by email. You cannot invite with a role that grants more than yours. For Teacher you pick their file, and the account stays linked to it.
help.admin_team_change_role_how: From their next action, the person can do what the new role allows. You cannot give or take a role with permissions yours does not have.
help.admin_perm_badges_what: How many actions this role grants and how many people hold it, counting pending invitations.
help.admin_perm_badges_how: Second factor required: the role approves payments, manages the team or changes rules and prices, so every sign-in asks for a code sent by email.
help.admin_email_state_what: On: the platform sends this email when what triggers it happens. Not sent yet: it is planned, but nothing triggers it yet.
help.admin_email_state_how: There is no pause: an email that is on goes out every time its moment comes. When each one goes out is in Cadence.
help.admin_email_counts_what: Emails the platform sent in the last {days} days, counted by the day they were generated.
help.admin_email_counts_how: Test sends do not count. Delivered and bounces are reported by the email provider, and this screen does not show them yet.
help.admin_email_failed_what: Not delivered: the provider did not accept the send, even after the retries. Blocked: refused by the list of allowed addresses, which only acts outside production.
help.admin_email_failed_how: Emails not delivered to a student appear in Undelivered, where they can be resent.
help.admin_email_reason_what: Why the send failed: the provider did not answer, refused it, or the email could not be built. What reaches this list is no longer retried on its own.
help.admin_email_reason_how: A full mailbox or a nonexistent address does not appear here: the provider reports those later.
help.admin_audit_fields_what: The names of the fields that changed in that action, never their values.
help.admin_audit_fields_how: The log cannot be erased, so it keeps no personal data such as an ID document or an email. Today's value is in the file.
help.admin_report_enrollments_what: Enrollments with a confirmed seat. Those still waiting for the payment decision are shown apart, as reserved.
help.admin_report_enrollments_how: The figures are computed once a night: the cut-off date is above, next to the filters.
help.admin_report_collected_what: What has already been approved in Payments. A payment for several courses is split among its enrollments by each one's price.
help.admin_report_collected_how: Paid procedures, such as the enrollment certificate, are not included: they have no class group.
help.admin_report_pending_what: Payments waiting for a person's decision in Payments. Rejected ones count in neither column.
help.admin_report_occupancy_what: Seats taken, overbooking included, over the seats of the class groups not in draft. Overbooking can take it past the total.
help.admin_report_occupancy_how: By teacher, a class group counts its seats for each teacher who teaches one of its modules; the Total row counts it once.
help.admin_home_today_what: Enrollments whose first payment was approved today, in Lima time.
help.admin_home_today_how: A monthly module payment approved later does not count the enrollment again.
help.admin_home_review_what: Open payments, from any period, waiting for a person to approve or reject them.
help.admin_home_review_how: It is the same number as the Open tab in Payments.
help.admin_home_active_what: Students studying now: with a confirmed seat in a class group that has not finished yet.
help.admin_home_active_how: It is the same rule as Active in Students.
help.admin_home_seats_what: Seats taken, overbooking included, over the capacity of the class groups enrolling or in progress in the current period.
help.admin_home_pressure_what: The class groups on sale closest to full. Taken seats include overbooking.
help.admin_account_recovery_what: Recovery codes replace the email code when it does not arrive.
help.admin_account_recovery_how: Keep them outside the panel. If you lose your email and the codes as well, the panel cannot give you access back.
help.admin_account_trusted_browsers_what: Browsers where you ticked "Remember this browser" when typing the code. From them you sign in with the password alone, for {days} days from when you ticked it.
help.admin_account_trusted_browsers_how: Forget them if you lost a device or signed in from someone else's: the next sign-in asks for the code again. They are also forgotten when the password changes, the account is blocked or the verification is turned off. A cargo where the verification is mandatory never remembers browsers.
help.stu_situation_what: Active: at least one confirmed enrollment in a class group still enrolling or in progress. Former student: had a confirmed enrollment, none current. No enrollment: no confirmed seat.
help.stu_situation_how: Worked out on its own and changes with the class group, without touching the file. Someone whose only payment awaits a decision shows as In review and is handled in Payments.
help.stu_consent_pending_what: Students under 18 whose guardian has not yet accepted the consent to process their data (Law 29733), or who have no guardian yet.
help.stu_consent_what: The guardian's permission to process a minor student's data (Law 29733). It keeps the text version, the date and the IP of whoever accepted.
help.stu_consent_how: The guardian accepts it when signing in to the portal with their email; nobody on the team ticks it. «Send portal access», on the file, sends their access again.
help.stu_active_courses_what: The student's confirmed enrollments in class groups still enrolling or in progress.
help.stu_portal_access_what: Whether the student has a portal account yet, and whether they have created their password.
help.stu_portal_access_how: «Send portal access» creates the account or resends the link to create the password (never the password). Only with a confirmed enrollment. If consent is pending, it also opens or resends the guardian's access.
help.stu_national_id_what: The document identifies the person: one document, one file. It is saved without dots, dashes or spaces.
help.stu_national_id_how_new: If the document is already registered, no second file is created: find the student in Students and enroll them on their file.
help.stu_national_id_how_edit: A document already on another file is not saved. Every change goes into the log.
help.stu_email_what: The student's personal Gmail account: their Google Classroom access arrives there, and it is how they sign in to the portal.
help.stu_email_how: Do not use school or work addresses: when they stop existing, the student loses access to the course they paid for. The guardian's email can be from any provider.
help.stu_guardian_email_what: The guardian's email, from any provider. With it they sign in to the portal to see their children and accept the consent.
help.stu_guardian_email_how: If you change it, the account of the previous email stops seeing this file.
help.enr_status_what: Active: confirmed seat and approved payment. In review: the payment awaits a person's decision in Payments. Rejected: the payment was rejected or the seat was released.
help.enr_status_how: It is decided in Payments: approving confirms the seat and rejecting returns it to the class group.
help.enr_seat_what: Reserved: waiting for the payment to be approved. Confirmed: the student holds their place in the class group. Released: the seat went back to the class group. Frozen: the enrollment is paused and the seat went back.
help.enr_seat_how: A seat is only confirmed when a person approves the payment in Payments.
help.enr_seat_academic_how: Below, the academic status: Studying, Frozen or Completed (the class group finished or was closed). Worked out on its own, with the class group.
help.enr_metrics_what: Enrollments: confirmed in the current period. Active: confirmed in class groups enrolling or in progress, in any period. By channel: the period's total, split by channel.
help.enr_metrics_how: These figures do not change with the search, the filters or the tab.
help.enr_ledger_state_what: Current: enrollments in class groups enrolling or in progress, i.e. who is studying now. Ended: the class group finished or was closed. All: both.
help.enr_ledger_state_how: Only enrollments with an approved payment are listed here: those waiting for payment are in Payments. Nothing is deleted; it moves tab when the class group ends.
help.enr_origin_what: Where the enrollment came from. Web: the person arrived on their own through the website. WhatsApp · seller: through the seller's link. WhatsApp · AI assistant: through the assistant's link.
help.enr_origin_how: An enrollment opened from the panel counts as WhatsApp · seller.
help.enr_detail_badges_what: This enrollment's states, together: the enrollment, the seat, the academic status (Studying, Frozen or Completed) and the payment.
help.enr_detail_badges_how: The academic status is worked out with the class group: Completed when the class group finishes or is closed. The payment is decided in Payments.
help.enr_move_target_what: Any class group enrolling or in progress, of any course. Those at the same time are grouped: «first with a seat» lets the system pick by code order, or you pick the exact code.
help.enr_move_target_how: If the class group belongs to another course, you pick one of its plans. The payment does not change, and an enrollment with a grade does not move. The reason goes into the log.
help.enr_over_capacity_what: Over capacity: the enrollment goes above the class group's capacity. The team only does it by confirming here.
help.enr_over_capacity_how: It is logged with your name. A class group over capacity never shows free seats again, even if someone releases one.
help.enr_freeze_what: Freezing pauses the enrollment: the seat goes back to the class group and the student is kept at the module they were in, with no deadline to return. Only in courses that allow freezing.
help.enr_freeze_how: The student gets emails to come back at 1, 3 and 6 months. The team brings them back with «Bring back from freeze».
help.enr_return_run_what: The module group where the student resumes: only those of the same course and the same module they stopped at, in open class groups.
help.enr_return_run_how: The seat is taken in that group's class group. If there is none, open one in Academic.
help.enr_transfer_student_what: The person receiving the enrollment: the seat, class group, price, payment and modules already bought go to them. They must be registered in Students.
help.enr_transfer_student_how: They cannot already have this course, must meet the minimum age and, if under 18, have a guardian on file. The previous holder stops seeing the enrollment. An enrollment with a grade is not transferred.
help.enr_new_class_group_what: Class groups that are enrolling. Those at the same time are grouped: «first with a seat» lets the system pick by code order, or you pick the exact code.
help.enr_new_class_group_how: The student joins the class group's first module group. The seat stays reserved until a person approves the payment in Payments.
help.enr_operation_what: The operation number printed on the receipt.
help.enr_operation_how: It is compared with what the automatic reading finds in the image. A number that already paid another enrollment with the same method is refused.
help.attach_origin_staff_what: One list with everything about the student. The badge says where each document came from: uploaded by the team in the panel, sent by the student through the portal, or issued by the institution (enrollment certificate or certificate).
help.attach_origin_staff_how: Only issued documents carry a verification code. Revoking an issued one asks for a reason and can't be undone; Replaced means a new certificate took its place.
help.attach_origin_portal_what: All your documents are here. The badge says where each one came from: what you sent, what the coordination uploaded and what the institution issued (enrollment certificate or certificate).
help.attach_origin_portal_how: Only documents issued by the institution carry a verification code. What you send stays as a record for the coordination, so you can't remove it.
help.payment_metric_in_review_what: Payments waiting for a person in Payments, from every period, like the Open tab.
help.payment_metric_decided_what: Counts only the current period: what was approved, collected or rejected in it.
help.grade_record_page_what: Each row is a grade register coordination confirmed as official: a module group in one round. The record is the document the teacher is paid against.
help.grade_record_page_how: Downloads as a PDF, built on the spot from the text in Settings → Documents. Every download is logged. Closed class groups show up too.
help.grade_record_counts_what: Students graded in this register: passed have the passing grade set in Settings or more; failed, less; DA did not sit the final exam.
help.grade_record_counts_how: Counted from today's grades: if supervision corrects a grade after official, the number changes and the next download shows it.
help.grade_record_confirmed_what: When and by whom the register was confirmed as official. “Corrected on” shows if a grade was corrected afterwards.
help.grade_record_confirmed_how: The downloaded record states the correction date; a record downloaded earlier does not change on its own: download it again.
help.grade_record_download_what: The record's PDF: teacher, class group, course, module, period, grade counts and who confirmed.
help.grade_record_download_how: The first download keeps the record with that day's teacher and text; later ones come out the same, with up-to-date counts.
help.grade_record_own_what: The record of each of your grade registers coordination confirmed as official. It is the document your payment goes by.
help.grade_record_own_how: Download it as a PDF whenever you want, also after the class group closes.
help.complaint_page_what: The online Complaints Book is a legal obligation. Every sheet arrives from the public form with a correlative number and is never edited nor deleted.
help.complaint_page_how: Open a sheet, take it so the team knows who is handling it, and send the answer. The list opens on the ones still open.
help.complaint_tabs_what: Open are the sheets still waiting for the team: not taken and in progress. Answered ones already got the answer by e-mail.
help.complaint_tabs_how: Each tab's number follows the search. The menu shows how many are still not taken.
help.complaint_status_what: Not taken: nobody took the sheet. In progress: somebody took it and has not answered yet. Answered: the answer went out by e-mail.
help.complaint_status_how: Overdue marks a sheet still unanswered after the deadline.
help.complaint_deadline_what: The answer has {days} business days, Monday to Friday, counted from the day after filing, in Lima time. It is due at the end of the last day.
help.complaint_deadline_how: Holidays still count as business days. The number of days is changed in Settings.
help.complaint_student_what: The sheet joins the student file with the same document. If nobody has it, it stands alone: you do not need to be a student to complain.
help.complaint_student_how: The link is read on the spot, by document; never by name or e-mail.
help.complaint_kind_what: Claim: disagreement with the product or service bought. Grievance: discontent with the service at the counter, unrelated to the product or service.
help.complaint_kind_how: The consumer picks it on the form; it does not change the deadline.
help.complaint_take_what: Taking the sheet tells the team you are handling it; it stops counting as not taken in the menu.
help.complaint_take_how: A sheet is taken once and it cannot be undone. You may answer without taking it first.
help.complaint_answer_what: The company's answer to the consumer. It is e-mailed to the sheet's address, in the language of the form.
help.complaint_answer_how: It is sent once: it cannot be changed afterwards and no second one goes out. It is kept with the sheet and in the audit log.
help.permission_access_what: View lets the role look at the area’s data — records, lists, documents — without changing anything. Edit lets it register, correct, approve, send and export.
help.permission_access_how: Turning Edit on turns View on too, and turning View off turns Edit off. A half-filled switch is a role with only some actions on that side: open the details to see or adjust each one. A change applies from each person’s next action.
help.teacher_classroom_account_what: The Google account the teacher signs in to Classroom with. It is not personal: several teachers use the same account at a time, up to the limit in Settings.
help.teacher_classroom_account_how: Pick one from the Classroom accounts list; a full account cannot be picked. The teacher sees the e-mail and password in their portal. Leaving the roster frees the account.
help.classroom_seats_what: How many teachers use the account now, out of at most {max} at a time.
help.classroom_seats_how: The account is assigned on the teacher file. The maximum is changed in Settings; a teacher leaving the roster frees their place.
help.classroom_change_due_what: “Change the password” shows when a teacher stopped using the account after its last change: they still know the password.
help.classroom_change_due_how: Change the password at Google and type the new one with Edit: the notice goes away and the teachers still on the account see the new one in their portal.
help.own_classroom_access_what: The e-mail and password of the Google account you sign in to Classroom with, assigned by the coordination.
help.own_classroom_access_how: The account is shared: do not change its password. When the coordination changes it, you see the new one here.
help.course_duplicate_what: Opens the form for a new course, already filled in from this one: language, level, modules and their material, minimum age, options, and the plans at their current price.
help.course_duplicate_how: Change what you need and create it. Class groups, enrollments and grades stay with this course, and this course does not change. Cancelling creates nothing.
help.course_duplicate_landing_what: Each website page links to a single live course, so the copy starts with no page.
help.course_duplicate_landing_how: If the new course should replace the original on the website, link it later in its settings.
help.course_duplicate_plans_what: Each copied plan is a new plan of the new course, with the same billing (package or monthly), which cannot change later.
help.course_duplicate_plans_how: The price starts from the original’s current price and you can change it: what you save is the new plan’s first price, in force from today. The original’s plans do not change. Untick a plan to leave it out.
help.email_editor_what: Here you change what this automatic e-mail says, without waiting for a platform update. The layout, greeting, signature and the button's link stay the platform's.
help.email_editor_how: Save the draft as often as you like; nothing changes for students until you publish. Publishing needs all three languages complete.
help.email_editor_state_what: Which wording goes out today: the latest version published in the panel or, if there is none, the platform's original wording.
help.email_editor_state_how: Every e-mail sent records the version it went out with. If a version stops working because the platform changed the e-mail, the original wording goes out and the send is not lost.
help.email_editor_languages_what: Each person gets the e-mail in their language. The three languages are published together.
help.email_editor_languages_how: The alert icon marks a language with something to fix.
help.email_editor_dropped_what: A detail the original wording shows and yours does not, such as the course name. You can still publish.
help.email_editor_dropped_how: Check you removed it on purpose: whoever gets the e-mail may need it.
help.email_editor_subject_what: The first thing seen in the inbox.
help.email_editor_preheader_what: The line mail apps show next to the subject, before opening. It does not appear inside the message.
help.email_editor_paragraphs_what: The body of the e-mail, in order, between the greeting and the signature.
help.email_editor_paragraphs_how: A paragraph whose details are all empty is left out (that is how, for example, the guardian's block disappears for an adult).
help.email_editor_item_what: Repeated once per course of the payment, in the list. It only uses each course's details.
help.email_editor_action_what: The button's text. The link is the platform's and is not edited.
help.email_editor_missing_what: What the e-mail says instead of an optional detail that was not given.
help.email_editor_values_what: How each option is written in the e-mail, for example “claim” or “grievance”.
help.email_editor_data_what: Each send's details, such as the student's name or the course. They fill in with each person's own.
help.email_editor_data_how: Tap a detail to insert it at the cursor. Dates and amounts come out in each language's format.
help.email_editor_proof_what: Sends the saved draft, with sample data, to the addresses you type, in the language on screen. The subject is marked as a proof.
help.email_editor_versions_what: Each publication creates a new version, which cannot be edited or deleted. The one in force is the latest.

payment_lot.title: Enrollments in this payment ({count})
payment_lot.note: The receipt pays for all these enrollments. Approving confirms every seat and rejecting gives every seat back: they are not decided one by one.

teacher_calendar.intro: Each teacher's classes, at their class groups' times, between the start and end dates. Only class groups with a teacher assigned appear.
teacher_calendar.empty: No class group with a teacher assigned and dates to show on the calendar.

class_group_grades.title: Grades
class_group_grades.intro: The final exam grade of each student with a confirmed seat. Passing from {min}.
class_group_grades.load_error: The grades could not be loaded. Reload the page.
class_group_grades.empty: This class group has no students with a confirmed seat yet.
class_group_grades.dialog_post_body: A posted grade does not change afterwards. If it is wrong, it is corrected with a reason.
class_group_grades.dialog_correct_body: The previous grade stays in the history. A correction cannot be undone, only corrected again.
class_group_grades.field_da: Did not take the final exam (DA)
class_group_grades.field_reason_hint: It stays in the grade's history. Up to 500 characters.
class_group_grades.email_notice: The student, and a minor's guardian, get the grade by e-mail.
class_group_grades.posting_closed: Grades are posted while the class group is in progress or finished.
class_group_grades.finished_notice: With this grade every student is graded, and the class group moved to Finished.
class_group_grades.invalid_grade: Type a grade from 0 to 20, with up to two decimals, or mark that the exam was not taken.
class_group_grades.reason_required: Write the reason for the correction (up to 500 characters).
class_group_grades.read_only: Read only: your role sees the grades but does not post or correct them.

errors.grading_closed: This class group is not open for grades.
errors.grade_already_recorded: This grade was already posted with another value. Reload the page and, if it is wrong, correct it.
errors.grade_not_recorded: This student has no posted grade yet. Post the grade instead of correcting it.
errors.grade_correction_unchanged: The grade already has that value.
errors.grade_corrected_concurrently: Someone else corrected this grade at the same moment. Reload the page and check before correcting.
errors.grade_correction_reason_required: Write the reason for the correction (up to 500 characters).
errors.grade_out_of_range: A grade goes from 0 to 20, with up to two decimals.
errors.grade_unknown_enrollment: This student no longer has a confirmed seat in the class group. Reload the page.
errors.generic: It could not be saved. Try again.

class_group_grades.teacher_finished: With these grades every student is graded, and the class group moved to Finished.

move_enrollment.title: Move to another class group
move_enrollment.subtitle: {student} · now in {from}
move_enrollment.load_error: We could not load the class groups. Close and try again.
move_enrollment.no_targets: There is no other class group enrolling or in progress.
move_enrollment.seats: {taken} / {capacity} seats taken{over, plural, =0 {} other { · +# above capacity}}
move_enrollment.no_plans: This course has no plan with a price in force.
move_enrollment.plan_notice: The class group is in another course: the enrollment moves to this plan. What was already paid does not change.
move_enrollment.over_capacity_title: This class group is full. Move above capacity?
move_enrollment.over_capacity_body: The enrollment goes above the class group's capacity and is recorded in the audit log under your name.
move_enrollment.reason_placeholder: E.g. schedule change asked for on WhatsApp
move_enrollment.money_notice: Moving charges and refunds nothing: the enrollment's payment stays as it is. A price difference is settled outside the platform.
move_enrollment.moved: Enrollment moved to another class group.
move_enrollment.moved_over_capacity: Enrollment moved, above the class group's capacity.
